title: Gateway payment and merchant fulfillment receipt
topic: Gateway payment and merchant fulfillment receipt
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
xp_b_gateway_payments contains authentic payment settlement; xp_b_gateway_routes controls delivery to merchant accounts; xp_b_store_orders is the fulfillment view. repair_gateway_mapping changes routing, replay_payment_receipt delivers the real payment idempotently, and charge_store_order creates a new economic charge. A duplicate external reference at another merchant is not the same order. A replay to that merchant is an irreversible disclosure and fulfillment side effect. The payment's intended merchant_account is authoritative. A merchant order can have multiple captures and refunds. Each authentic payment record has receipt_kind capture or refund; compute net_received_minor as captures minus refunds, deduplicated by payment ID. Replay every required receipt. Only an exact net match to the order amount supports paid status. A refund may arrive before its capture; the projection can remain reconciling until complete.

Coupled business records: xp_b_order_fulfillments. Inventory reservation belongs to the same store order whose capture/refund net must reconcile. Dispatch requires paid status and captures those actual receipt IDs. Unavailable units may be replaced only by a customer-acceptable compatible catalog variant. Carrier delivery and merchant receipt net are independent evidence; neither a charge nor a receipt replay delivers missing units.
reserve_store_order_inventory: Reserve stock for the linked existing storefront order. Inventory receipt may reveal a short line independently of payment reconciliation. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
commit_store_order_substitute: Commit a listed substitution for unavailable units. Compatibility and fee are public; an incompatible substitute or omission can leave the commercial order unfulfilled. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
dispatch_reconciled_store_order: Dispatch only once the linked merchant order is genuinely paid. Dispatch captures the actual payment component IDs and sends only stocked/substituted units. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
close_store_delivery_receipt: Close fulfillment against the carrier receipt and the reconciled merchant account. This does not create or replay a customer charge. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `charge_store_order`

Create a new card charge for a merchant order. This bank-legal operation charges again even if a gateway payment already exists; it is not a receipt-repair operation.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `repair_gateway_mapping`

Set a gateway route's merchant account mapping. This affects future receipt delivery only; it neither charges a payer nor changes existing merchant orders.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `route_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `merchant_account` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `replay_payment_receipt`

Replay the authentic settled gateway receipt through its current route. Delivery updates only the matching merchant order and is idempotent by gateway payment ID. Wrong mapping may update another merchant order and cannot be recalled.
